meaning:
1) plait, chaplet, wreath, crown
1a) plait, coronet, diadem

elsewhere.note: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
